prompts.name: mounted
prompts.prompt: Production pixel sprite sheet for the existing side-scrolling military arcade game. TWO exact rows, FOUR columns, eight independent sprites, all fully visible and riding to the RIGHT on exactly the same vintage olive green motorcycle as in the reference: rear canvas pannier, rolled bedroll, white star on fuel tank, two equal black tires, round headlamp. The first reference's LEFT image is the authoritative soldier character. In row 1 match its exact charming compact arcade proportions: big domed olive helmet, prominent white eye and black pupil under visor, short round face, big gloves and boots, olive utility vest with rectangular pouches, small square backpack, folded short sleeves and bare forearms. Avoid tiny realistically proportioned heads or balaclava. Use chunky low-resolution opaque pixel clusters and dark outlines exactly like this on-foot sprite. In row 2, the SAME motorcycle ridden by the superhero on the far RIGHT of the second reference: navy blue armor, bright blue eyes, red cape blown backward; keep both wheels visible. For BOTH rows the four poses are 1 riding upright gripping both handlebars, 2 accelerating with torso lowered, 3 attack while mounted (soldier's right arm extended forward holding small level handgun, visible clear dark barrel tip and SMALL bright orange muzzle flash; superhero looking straight ahead, hands on handlebars, clear blue eyes and NO rays), 4 suspension extended over a jump with knees flexed and front wheel slightly high. Strict side view, constant style, wheelbase, tire size and height of seated character. Large regular transparent gutters between cells. All eight sprites on genuine transparent background, no letters, labels, scenery, gradients, drop shadows or borders.

prompts.name: fallA
prompts.prompt: Game production, 3-row by 5-column sprite sheet (15 independent side-view full-body sprites, consistent scale). Create a rider-only stunt fall animation for each of the 3 characters in the reference. Row one exclusively the infantryman at left, with his exact chunky arcade proportions, large olive helmet and visible white eye, short sleeved green fatigues, square backpack and boots. Row two exclusively the grey wolfman, grey ears, snout, white tail, olive khakis and pack. Row three exclusively the pale zombie soldier, olive helmet, pale ashen sickly face, cyan eyes and olive military uniform. All face right. Across EACH row, precisely five distinct anatomical key poses: (1) airborne body pitched diagonally head first toward RIGHT, arms reaching out, folded knees and boots trailing behind; (2) shoulder hitting the pavement, compact sideways tumble, chin tucked, hips raised; (3) sprawled low on belly on the ground, elbows in front, feet behind; (4) one knee down, other boot planted pushing torso up with gloved hands; (5) crouched stepping up with one knee high, arms extended forward gripping imaginary handlebars as rider remounts. Show characters ONLY, no motorcycle, no street, no smoke or debris. Preserve chunky retro arcade sprite pixel clusters, faces and palette of the reference exactly. Same body mass and head size across all 5 frames, strong clear silhouettes, all feet and hands inside the cell, generous transparent gutters between sprites. Transparent background, no labels, grids, motion trails or terrain.

prompts.name: fallB
prompts.prompt: Production game sprite sheet: strict regular THREE rows and FIVE columns on genuine transparency, 15 full-body characters ONLY, no vehicles. The reference establishes exact character designs in order. ROW 1: existing military cyborg with olive helmet, red single eye, silver mechanical face and arms, olive combat trousers and boots. ROW 2: existing human martial artist with jet-black hair, red headband with twin tails, olive short-sleeve fatigues, military boots. ROW 3: existing caped superhero in navy blue segmented armor, cyan eyes, brown hair and RED cape billowing out behind. Each row shows ONE identical-sized actor across five distinct anatomically convincing motorcycle wreck key poses, facing RIGHT: 1) airborne falling head first to the right, front arms reaching out, boots trail upward left; 2) tucking into a shoulder roll, curved back contacts ground and knees curl up; 3) sprawled flat on belly, head still on right, elbows near ground, boots extended to left; 4) pushing up from one knee, one boot firmly planted; 5) standing crouched mid step-over with one knee lifted, hands extended to grip imaginary handlebars. NO motorcycle nor ground. Strict side view, chunky pixel art arcade style with dark outlines, strong clusters, same readable proportions and palette as reference. Keep head and body mass the same across each row; five widely separated columns, full bodies within each cell. No shadows, text, particles, horizontal rules, captions or grid.

prompts.name: bike
prompts.prompt: A single professional arcade sprite strip on transparent background with FOUR independent depictions of the SAME EMPTY motorcycle. Extract the olive military motorcycle common to the reference. No people, no tank. Vintage rounded olive fuel tank with a white star, black saddle, rolled bedroll and pannier at back on LEFT, round headlamp and front wheel on RIGHT. Strict pixel-art in the style of the reference, dark chunky outlines, olive metal, black tires, silver hubs. Four side-view/side-tilt key poses in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW: (1) EMPTY motorcycle standing upright, strict right-facing side profile, level tires; (2) same motorcycle banking halfway onto its side towards the viewer, front wheel slightly skewed; (3) fully tipped over on its near side on the asphalt, still oriented rightwards, both wheels visible as low foreshortened ellipses and tank and handlebar on the ground; (4) tipped motorcycle being lifted halfway upright, suspension relaxed, before settling onto two tires. All four have same physical wheelbase and paint scheme, no ground or shadow or rider. All fully visible, separated with wide transparent gutters. No text, numbers, smoke, dust or decorative marks.

prompts.name: tank
prompts.prompt: Pixel-art game asset. Five distinct frames in a single horizontal 1x5 sprite strip on transparent background. Depict ONLY the little olive-gold tracked tank from the BOTTOM RIGHT of the reference, facing RIGHT, with identical chunky low hull, small angular turret, blue viewing slit, silver barrel pointing forward, track wheels, compact arcade proportions and dark pixel outlines. This is a non-destructive pothole accident animation. 1 conventional level right-facing strict side view, 2 front suspension collapses and rear tracks lift as the nose tips down on impact, 3 tank skids tilted on the near track showing a little of the top armored deck, 4 rocking back onto level tracks, suspension bouncing and barrel counterbalancing, 5 fully level and ready to drive again. Maintain same physical scale, hull proportions, barrel length and palette across every view. All 5 vehicles fully in separate evenly spaced columns with generous clear margins, flat side-scrolling orthographic camera. No people, bikes, smoke, fire or sparks, no ground, no letters or labels.

prompts.name: convoy
prompts.prompt: Two by five production pixel-art sprite atlas on real transparency for a side-scrolling motorcycle chase. Reference role: exact enemy designs and bikes. Draw only the first two vehicles from the reference in FIVE action frames each, never the jeep. TOP row: one lone military bandit rider with olive helmet and RED scarf aboard his red motorcycle, facing right, firing backwards. BOTTOM row: exactly two helmeted crewmen with olive uniforms on the olive military motorcycle with machine-gun sidecar. Consistent chunky arcade art and same wheelbase, helmet and uniforms, same proportions as reference. Five full sprites across each row show a continuous irreversible arcade wipeout: 1 losing traction, vehicle beginning to tip and biker just coming off the saddle; 2 bike skidding forward right, all crew pitched off backwards-left in the air, hands released; 3 crew rolling onto the ground left of vehicle as it tips down-right; 4 crew sliding low against ground and bike sliding on its side; 5 motionless crew resting fully on ground beside fallen red motorcycle or overturned sidecar. No gore. In every cell keep the identity/number of riders and correct vehicle, red single or olive sidecar, all bodies and wheels entirely inside its own space. Consistent sprite scale, leave generous transparent clear gutters. No ground, cast shadows, debris, motion blur, smoke, text, gridlines or decorative indicators.
